verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's RTX 5070 family page documents local AI model inference on this GPU, with curated GPU-optimized SDKs and support across Windows ML, Ollama, PyTorch and other inference backends. The CUDA toolkit offers AI libraries and NGC containers, and the 16 GB of GDDR7 at 896 GB/s is relevant to LLM sizing. However, the evidence never mentions FP8/FP4 low-precision formats or the named serving stacks for this part. Missing for 10: documented FP8/FP4 support, explicit TensorRT-LLM/vLLM/llama.cpp support for the 5070 Ti, LLM-specific inference documentation, and independent hands-on LLM benchmarks.
